description: Put the whole project back as a version held it (every model, file and dashboard; anything added since is removed, and a file goes to the Bin), only when the user asks to undo or go back; it always waits for their approval. version is an id or name from history (of "versions"). Edits not yet in a version are saved first, and the restore is itself a version, so it can be undone by restoring the one before. The restore runs on the server and takes up to a minute: this waits briefly, and if status is still "pending" read history (of "versions") until it says done or failed. Which version is meant must be clear: ask when it is not.

project.description: Project name or id; the open project when absent.

name: restore_version
